The admission process for various programmes at KLE Technological University (BVB Engineering College) involves the following steps:

1. A candidate seeking admission under the Government Quota follows the procedures of the Post Graduate Common Entrance Test as notified by the Government of Karnataka from time to time.
2. A candidate seeking admission under the University Quota appears for the entrance test conducted by the University or by recognized Entrance Examination authorities such as KEA/CMAT/MAT/CAT.
3. The University may conduct Counseling for admissions based on the rankings in the entrance test (if conducted) or directly admit candidates allotted by the central counseling conducted by the Examination Authorities.
4. Candidates who have passed a qualifying examination not conducted by the Government of Karnataka or University must submit the eligibility and migration certificate in original for admission to a programme of study.
5. NRI/PIO/FN seeking admission to a programme must apply separately with equivalency/eligibility/migration certificates along with passport/visa/clearance/NOC from concerned bodies to the Admissions Committee.
6. Admission is subject to the candidate being certified medically fit by a registered medical practitioner recognized by the University for the purpose.
7. Each applicant must submit a Character Certificate from the head of the institution last attended.

It was approved by the Board of Governors (BOG) with an additional term loan of Rs. 5 crores for its construction.
